sv.title: Återstarten av Ringhals dröjer flera veckor
sv.summary: Återstarten av ena reaktorn i Ringhals kärnkraftverk försenas ytterligare. Ringhals 3 skulle ha återstartats den 5 december. men nu dröjer återstarten till 21 december. Den senaste tiden avstängda reaktorer har bidragit till de höga elpriserna.

en.title: Restart of Ringhals delayed by several weeks
en.summary: The restart of one reactor at the Ringhals nuclear power plant is further delayed. Ringhals 3 was to have restarted on 5 December, but now the restart is delayed until 21 December. Recently, shut-down reactors have contributed to high electricity prices.
